desc: Read input – parse N, X, Y, and strings S, T.
Check non‑negativity – if any prefix sum becomes negative, output "No".
Check residue‑wise balance – for each residue r in 0..d-1 (d = X+Y), verify that the sum of diff over positions with index ≡ r (mod d) is zero and no partial prefix inside that residue goes negative.
Output result – print "Yes" if all checks pass, otherwise "No".
